customer_documents_number_check.name: customer_documents_number_check
customer_documents_number_check.value: ("customer_documents"."number_ciphertext" is null) = ("customer_documents"."number_key_id" is null) and ("customer_documents"."number_ciphertext" is null) = ("customer_documents"."number_lookup" is null) and ("customer_documents"."number_ciphertext" is null) = ("customer_documents"."number_lookup_key_id" is null) and ("customer_documents"."number_ciphertext" is null) = ("customer_documents"."number_hint" is null)

customer_documents_dates_check.name: customer_documents_dates_check
customer_documents_dates_check.value: "customer_documents"."valid_from" is null or "customer_documents"."valid_until" is null or "customer_documents"."valid_from" <= "customer_documents"."valid_until"

customer_documents_void_check.name: customer_documents_void_check
customer_documents_void_check.value: ("customer_documents"."record_state" = 'voided') = ("customer_documents"."voided_at" is not null and "customer_documents"."voided_reason" is not null)

customer_documents_entry_check.name: customer_documents_entry_check
customer_documents_entry_check.value: "customer_documents"."type" <> 'entry_record' or ("customer_documents"."entry_date" is not null and "customer_documents"."number_ciphertext" is null)

customers_contact_check.name: customers_contact_check
customers_contact_check.value: "customers"."phone_e164" is not null or "customers"."email" is not null or "customers"."status" = 'anonymized'

customers_email_check.name: customers_email_check
customers_email_check.value: "customers"."email" is null or ("customers"."email" = lower("customers"."email") and "customers"."email" like '%_@_%')

customers_country_check.name: customers_country_check
customers_country_check.value: ("customers"."nationality" is null or "customers"."nationality" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$') and ("customers"."address_country" is null or "customers"."address_country" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$')

customers_archive_check.name: customers_archive_check
customers_archive_check.value: ("customers"."status" = 'archived') = ("customers"."archived_at" is not null and "customers"."archived_reason" is not null)

customers_merged_check.name: customers_merged_check
customers_merged_check.value: ("customers"."status" = 'merged') = ("customers"."merged_into_id" is not null) and "customers"."merged_into_id" is distinct from "customers"."id"

document_requirement_policies_active_che.name: document_requirement_policies_active_check
document_requirement_policies_active_che.value: "document_requirement_policies"."status" = 'draft' or "document_requirement_policies"."activated_at" is not null or "document_requirement_policies"."retired_at" is not null

vehicle_documents_dates_check.name: vehicle_documents_dates_check
vehicle_documents_dates_check.value: "vehicle_documents"."valid_from" is null or "vehicle_documents"."valid_until" is null or "vehicle_documents"."valid_from" <= "vehicle_documents"."valid_until"

vehicle_documents_void_check.name: vehicle_documents_void_check
vehicle_documents_void_check.value: ("vehicle_documents"."record_state" = 'voided') = ("vehicle_documents"."voided_at" is not null and "vehicle_documents"."voided_reason" is not null)

vehicles_cost_check.name: vehicles_cost_check
vehicles_cost_check.value: ("vehicles"."acquisition_cost_minor" is null) = ("vehicles"."acquisition_currency" is null) and ("vehicles"."acquisition_cost_minor" is null or "vehicles"."acquisition_cost_minor" >= 0)
